title: customer-success
text:
customer-success

ana: FYI — HelixCare private cutover scheduled 09:00 PT. Staging call found three issues: healthchecks blocked by their firewall, KMS alias swap failing during rotation, and audit logs not reaching our ingest bucket. Marking medium renewal-risk until resolved.

raj: Network note — their firewall returns RSTs to probes. Suggest they add two inbound rules for our probe CIDRs. I'll paste a cloud console example.

raj: FW example:
Inbound: TCP 8080 from 54.12.34.56/32, TCP 443 from 54.12.34.57/32

sophie: KMS: rotation failure due to key policy denying cross-account kms:GenerateDataKey during alias update. Need their KMS ARN + account id so we can share a trust template. Recommend staged approach: create new key, test re-encrypt on small corpus, flip alias, then full rekey.

ana: ops-bot created ticket CS-92110 and linked runbook https://runbooks.redwood.com/priv-deploys/cutover-checklist

ana: Action owners:
- raj: send FW snippet to customer by EOD
- sophie: provide KMS trust policy + alias-swap example by 18:00 PT
- ana: coordinate audit ingest test and request s3 presigned upload for proof

ana: If these complete within 24h risk -> low. Tagging @raj @sophie — please update when done. :thumbsup:
